options.content:
## About

These graphs show you the current status of our clusters and which tools are being run on [UseGalaxy.eu](https://usegalaxy.eu). Our primary cluster is a Condor cluster running in the [deNBI cloud](https://www.denbi.de/).

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") FROM "queue-overview" WHERE ("state" = 'new' AND ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m), "tool_id", "state" fill(null)

SELECT sum("count") FROM "queue-overview" WHERE ("state" = 'queued' AND ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "tool_id", "state" fill(null)
SELECT mean("count") FROM "cluster.queue" WHERE ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "state" fill(none)

SELECT sum("count")  / 5 FROM "queue-overview" WHERE ("state" = 'running' AND ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat')) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m), "tool_id", "tool_version" fill(null)
SELECT mean("count") FROM "upload-gb-in-past-hour" WHERE ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(0)

SELECT sum("count")  / 5 FROM "queue-overview" WHERE ("state" = 'running' AND ("host" = 'maintenance.galaxyproject.eu' OR "host"='maintenance.bi.privat') AND "destination_id"::tag =~ /pulsar/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.description:
Users can connect Galaxy to their own storage that Galaxy you can run tools and workflows against.

This dashboard shows how many users are using each kind of object store that is supported.

Read more [here](https://galaxyproject.org/eu/storage/#user-owned-storage).

targets.query: SELECT LAST("user_count") as "Count" FROM "user_object_store_utilisation" GROUP BY "template_id"::tag

panels.title: Object store utilization (BYOS)
